0022600130.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) visit the San Antonio Spurs (1-2, winners of their last game), with Sacramento 15th in the West and San Antonio 9th. The Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while the Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Spurs swept the Kings 3-0 in the 2025-26 season, most recently winning 132-104 in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
